profile.headline: Software engineer with who loves cybersecurity and ML. Confidential compute and passwordless enthusiast.
profile.summary: Proven track record guiding startups through launch and growth via technical leadership. Specializing in software engineering, cybersecurity, machine learning. Diverse background that includes professional teaching, software development, and academic research in machine learning and cybersecurity. Holds a Master of Science in Computer and Information Sciences from College of Charleston.

positions.title: Lead Developer
positions.description: Played a principal role in developing innovative technologies for Call Experts, which were instrumental in the successful launch of subsidiary Abridged Tech. Led the development of a hybrid cloud and on-premises REST API infrastructure serving thousands of monthly users. Deployed an AWS infrastructure for call data handling, recording, and transcription, integrated with both SQL Server via RDS and DynamoDB. Automated resource provisioning through novel Infrastructure as Code tools. Implemented security best practices for encryption, secret management, and access control. Published and maintained private npm libraries for shared functionality. Developed CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions for npm libraries and various services. Served as primary technical resource for Dev and IT teams. Created data visualization dashboards for clients using React and D3.

positions.title: JRS Coding School Instructor
positions.description: Instruct a students to build full-stack applications using JavaScript, React, and NodeJS. Teach students web-development programming basics (HTML, CSS, and JavaScript), computer science/programming concepts (Functional Programming, Recursion, Asynchronous Programming), database concepts and tools (MongoDB, PostGreSQL, MongoDB Atlas), server-side frameworks and libraries (NodeJS), user authentication (bcrypt, AWS Cognito, Auth0), API Design and REST Routing (Express), and React/Redux as front-end framework for responsive, programmatic website design. Teach students to integrate with and deploy full stack apps to AWS.

positions.title: Adjunct Professor
positions.description: Teach an undergraduate class, Principles and Practices of Cybersecurity. Create lectures, lessons, exercises, and tests for undergraduate students to increase their awareness of cybersecurity. Show students possible threats to their information security and ways to mitigate potential threats.

positions.title: Graduate Research Assistant for Intrusion Detection
positions.description:
Work under supervision of Dr. Xenia Mountrouidou, head of College of Charleston’s Cybersecurity X Lab.  Conduct research on feature extraction and selection for network intrusion detection.  Select optimal feature sets for machine learning models with various feature selection algorithms.  Train machine learning models to improve malicious network traffic detection.  Compose a framework for automating the selection of interchangeable machine learning algorithms, feature sets, feature selection algorithms, and data sets for easy implementation of machine learning intrusion detection systems (IDS).
Highlights:
•	Conduct research on creating IDS features by considering multiple packet attributes over varying lengths of time. Investigate the usefulness of time window optimization on different attacks.
•	Act as principal developer an extensible network IDS framework. Design this framework to contain interchangeable components for ease of selection, as well as simple addition of new machine learning algorithms, feature selection algorithms, data sets, etc., allowing focus on one of these components at a time for researchers or businesses.
•	Prepare machine learning and feature selection algorithms to be run in parallel on Google Cloud to reduce running time.
•	Work to coordinate personal research and software projects with the overall research goals of the lab, including system state prediction, IOT taxonomy, and models of correct operation of IOT.

positions.title: Graduate Assistant
positions.description:
Assist Dr. Ayman Hajja and Dr. George Pothering with their respective classes, CS250 Introduction To Computer Organization & Assembly Language and CS221 Computer Programming II-Java Object-Oriented Programming.
Highlights:
•	Grade student assignments, quizzes, and tests based on correctness and comprehension.
•	Hold office hours for CS250 students requesting help with class material.
•	Maintain working knowledge of class concepts, including C programming language basics, MIPS assembly language and binary machine code, digital logic circuitry, and Java-specific object-oriented concepts.

positions.title: Graduate Research Assistant Software Developer
positions.description:
Work under supervision of Dr. James Bowring, head of Cyber Infrastructure Research & Development Lab for the Earth Sciences (CIRDLES).  Assist Dr. Bowring in the development of Squid 3.0, a Java desktop application reimplementation of Squid 2.5, a popular geochronology software for the processing of raw mass spectrometer XML data, previously implemented in Microsoft Excel 2003 Visual Basic.
Highlights:
•	Build a Java/JavaFX desktop application using software engineering principles.
•	Collaborate with team using GitHub for version control.
•	Create and alter existing data structures in code to improve program functionality.
•	Unit test code additions using JUnit testing framework.

positions.title: Office Manager/Head of Customer Service
positions.description:
Manage a wide variety of tasks to effectively operate a vacation rental business in downtown Charleston, SC.  Create a new website to improve customer and employee experience.  Remain the first contact for a diverse group of guests, clients, employees, and contractors.
Highlights:
•	Remain primary contact for up to 218 guests and up to 15 employees/contractors during office hours and on call after hours during nights and weekends.
•	Act as member of team that nearly doubled business size in a few years in terms of properties, employees, and guests.
•	Answer 300+ emails and 30+ incoming phone calls daily involved with all facets of business operation.
•	Manage and coordinate office, maintenance, and housekeeping staffs.
•	Create a new company website with new features and improved simplicity and appearance.

projects.title: Tom Riddle's Password Diary
projects.description: Cackalackycon '26 presentation and demo. Speak to the memory of Tom Riddle using only the sound of writing on paper.

projects.title: How to hear a password
projects.description:
In this presentation, I describe the full process of training and deploying an ML model to perform an audio-based side channel attack to interpret written characters with high accuracy in real-time. I describe code to record audio, create spectrogram images from the audio’s frequencies, train and deploy a CNN model in Google Vertex, and create an AWS/NextJS app and infrastructure to slice and send audio samples to the deployed model for prediction, and see the predicted samples in the client-side app.
https://www.meetup.com/charleston-data-science/events/298850597
